tokens.name: line

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunk and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata and help text on bg, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active nav marker, revenue in charts. Text on it is on-brand. Hi-Vis yellow is below 3:1 on bg and surface, so every Hi-Vis brand fill there carries an ink edge.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. Dark in Hi-Vis: white fails on safety yellow.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand as text: links, active tab labels, on bg, surface and brand-soft. In Hi-Vis a dark gold, because yellow cannot be read as text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected rows, current lifecycle step, info pills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: One highlight per view: the signup CTA on a shell ground, a due-soon marker. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Dark ground: app navigation and marketing hero bands.

tokens.name: shell-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and active rows, and cards, on shell.

tokens.name: on-shell
tokens.usage: Primary text on shell and shell-raised.

tokens.name: on-shell-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on shell and shell-raised.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Paid, awarded, on schedule: text on success-soft and surface, or a fill under white text. Teal, not green, so it stays apart from danger for red-green colour blindness.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, awaiting approval: text on warning-soft and surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, over budget, lost bid: text on danger-soft and surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: chart-profit
tokens.usage: Profit line and margin figures.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus outline, 2px offset, on bg and surface. On shell the outline is on-shell.
